_doc: See docs/VLLM-SETUP.md for deployment guide and docs/MODEL-ROUTING.md for role definitions
_format: Three config formats supported (all backwards compatible):
_format_legacy: 1. Legacy: string modelMap + ollamaBaseUrl (auto-migrated to defaultBaseUrl)
_format_hybrid: 2. Hybrid: some roles as objects with baseUrl, rest as strings using defaultBaseUrl
_format_full: 3. Full: all roles as objects with explicit baseUrl per backend

_comment_roles.triage: Skill routing — lightweight, fast (9B). Points to vLLM on port 8000 for <3s latency
_comment_roles.default: Primary model for diagnosis + execution (fast MoE). Uses Ollama via defaultBaseUrl
_comment_roles.strategic: Fix planning + self-heal corrections — deep reasoning (122B MoE)
_comment_roles.worker: Self-heal corrections (first tier). Can point to vLLM for fast corrections

_example_legacy._note: Legacy format: all strings, single base URL. ollamaBaseUrl auto-migrated to defaultBaseUrl

_example_full_vllm._note: Full vLLM format: every role gets an explicit baseUrl (multi-GPU deployment)
